description:
## What changed

A polish release. No patches were added or removed. Most of it makes the settings screen and the Feature Gate Lab read as one app, with a round of accessibility fixes and a changelog Morphe Manager can finally read.

**Manager shows what changed again.** Manager fills its update screen from this project's CHANGELOG, and it only recognizes a version heading that ends in a date. Every heading from 0.23.0 on had none, so Manager's list stopped at 0.22.0 and each update since then arrived with nothing to show. The headings carry their dates now, and each entry names TikTok, which is what Manager looks for before it flags an app as having a patch update. Every patch description also says where its switches live, so choosing a patch in Manager tells you which settings page to open afterwards.

**Settings.** Search keeps what you typed through a rotation or a text size change, and the keyboard no longer covers the last results. A search result scrolls into view with some of the page above it and flashes so you can find it. A setting at zero says what zero means, like "No delay" or "TikTok's size". Pages slide in the direction you're going. Titles break between words at large text sizes. Disabled text in the light theme meets the 4.5:1 contrast floor, and dialogs share one corner radius, one set of margins and one title size. Browse in a download folder dialog no longer throws away what you typed, and a folder Hushfeed can't use says why under the field.

**The Feature Gate Lab.** It looks like the rest of settings now. Titles and section headings match the other pages, the tabs and the scope row underline their choice the same way, and the two account warnings sit inside a card instead of floating as loose orange text. A field that can't be saved is marked where it is. Holding a gate to select several is easier to find, and the list scrolls without reading storage for every row.

**On the video.** The ring that arms a Follow or Like confirmation shows up on TikTok's red buttons, and arming it vibrates. Block, local hide, block sound and Not interested vibrate when tapped. When automatic advance stops at its limit, a Keep going button starts another run from the video you're on. A block or a sticker save in progress stays readable instead of fading into the video behind it.

**Accessibility.** TalkBack hears "Blocking" and "Saving" while those run, and hears the Hook status row's state before the rest of the row. The range dialog's labels are read once instead of twice, and so is a gate's expanded section. Done on a dialog's keyboard saves it, number keyboards included.

**Validation.** 1408 runtime tests and 225 patch tests passed locally. The receipt attached below records all 90 patches applying to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with the real desktop CLI. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

Everything in this release is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
